Examples.Title: Get API key usage
Examples.Description: Returns an API key's cost over a time period, in total and by price.
Examples.Code:
### Get API key usage
# @name get-api-key-usage
GET {{host}}/api-keys/{{id}}/usage?start_date=2025-01-01T00:00:00Z&end_date=2025-01-31T23:59:59Z&group_by=day
x-api-key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Usage data retrieved successfully
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing service key
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not Found - API key does not exist
# Content-Type: application/json
# 500
# Description: Internal Server Error - Failed to fetch usage data
# Content-Type: application/json
